title: Pay per newly covered item
hook: The value of a set changes after its neighbours have been chosen.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Choose a set by cost per uncovered element and recompute that ratio after each choice.

misconception: A set's original size stays its value after some elements are already covered.
objective: Choose a set by cost per uncovered element and recompute that ratio after each choice.

claims.text: Only newly covered elements belong in the denominator. Once a set is chosen, overlap changes the remaining ratios. This is a greedy approximation, not a promise that the lowest immediate ratio always leads to a globally cheapest cover.
